notes.title: Version 4.9 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/527604c9dfe054da6469b5d35ea6285c0516330c.png[/img]

Senpai!

[b]At long last, it's here! Version 4.9, the last of the TENGOKU: Four Towers series![/b]



[h2][b]1) NEO M.I.L.K Area Revealed! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

After the maintenance on 5/28, for those of you that have made it to Floor 100 of TENGOKU, you’ll be presented with an escalator on Floor 51 that leads to the NEO M.I.L.K area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/821244e31f8fd50bc3e081931d8dd8c2ad5c3bf2.jpg[/img]

The NEO M.I.L.K area coming this patch is an extremely challenging area where all enemies are significantly strengthened, even by TENGOKU standards. Within the area, all M.I.L.K armor and weapons will receive a large faction bonus buff to their stats. It is highly recommended that players bring all M.I.L.K equipment when stepping up to this challenge. But select your items carefully before climbing up these floors; there will be a limit to the number of items you can take in your Death Bag.

Of course, with an immense challenge comes immense rewards. Within the area, players have increased chances of obtaining rare M.I.L.K metals, and the equipment obtained here is of similar quality to that of TENGOKU Floor 100.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/d8c0e18e8cdb6121c26398fa2cfa57fc7c226f10.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]2) Pale Wind (HELL) Unleashed! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

The NEO M.I.L.K area features a new difficulty of a returning boss: Pale Wind of the 4 FORCEMEN can now be fought at the "HELL" difficulty! He'll appear every 10 floors that you progress within the NEO M.I.L.K area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/91ea0d6ac1924431f394b69def06f1ab73cfe19d.jpg[/img]

Defeat this high-difficulty FORCEMEN for rare items and new blueprints! Luckily, the "HELL" difficulty has no battle fee and no time limit during battles. However, if you are defeated, there will be a corpse retrieval cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/edce1bc55efd03c7816d26df374e0504cf23e56b.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]3) Bloodnium Limit Increased! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance)～[/i]

The Bloodnium limit has been increased from 99999  to 999999!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/8314943f0a08b115b3fa25a137f4b32b15eff07f.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]4) NEO M.I.L.K Area Opening Event Will Be Held at the Same Time! [/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 5/28/2025 (Post Maintenance) – 6/30/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

[url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7360/]Click here for more information[/url]

*Please note that event duration and content may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances.

notes.title: Celebrating 8 Years of LET IT DIE!
notes.content:
[i]8th Anniversary Event Duration: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance) – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/f87167fba7fc84ce4dc45f256fd940014e90c24e.png[/img]

Yo, Senpai!

[b]LET IT DIE celebrates its 8th anniversary on 12/4/2024!*[/b]

LET IT DIE, my baby, is now 8—the symbol of infinite chaos! Time flies when you're having fun... No tears here, I swear! I don't even have eyes! (Or maybe I do?)

This year's anniversary event is set to be a sick one, packed with some seriously epic surprises to mark 8 years of unforgettable mayhem.

Thank you, Senpai, for making these years so deadly fun—let's keep it going!

[i]*LET IT DIE was released in the U.S./Europe on 12/4/2016.[/i]





[h2][b]● Additional item for redecorating the Waiting Room![/b][/h2]

An additional free item has been added to celebrate the LET IT DIE 8th anniversary!
The item is redeemable after the start of the event with no time restriction.
Please check inside the [Metro Front]-[Waiting Room]-[Remodel]

"Promotion Poster Momoko"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/eb557fdacfc6bc094ab75a68a6395aef680367da.jpg[/img]




[h2][b]● 8th Anniversary Special Login Bonuses[/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance)– 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

For a little over a month, we will hold special 8th anniversary login bonuses where you can get gorgeous items every day. If you log in during the event period, you’ll get the following the first time you log-in!

[list]
[*] Revived Item: "X-RATED Glasses (Blueprint)"
[*] Lost Bag: Rainbow×3 bags
[*] 200,000 Kill Coins (40,000 Kill Coins x 5)
[*] 200,000 SPLithium (40,000 SPLithium x 5)
[/list]

The X-RATED Glasses finally make their return!
These funky shades will raise a Fighter’s STR and STM by 6%!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/0458558a07ddc40370aac8b5cb99ecaebf605d0b.jpg[/img]

In addition, depending on the day and time you logged in and the floor you reach in the Tower of Barbs, you will receive many more items!

[i]Additional details about the rewards can be viewed on our website[/i]: 
https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7286/


Notes:
[list]
[*] During the event, the regular daily log-in bonuses will be replaced with the bonuses outlined above.
[*] Storage space inside the Reward Box is limited. If the number of items in your Reward Box exceeds the maximum number of available storage slots, you will need to remove some items from your Reward Box in order to receive new items.
[/list]




[h2][b]● 8th Anniversary MushFests![/b][/h2]
Event Periods:
– 11/28/2024 18:00 – 12/9/2024 17:59 (PST)
– 12/12/2024 18:00  – 12/23/2024 17:59 (PST)
– 12/26/2024 18:00 – 1/6/2025 17:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/315d78f347af43df3ab0096a0fdae43d06092604.png[/img]

There will be THREE extra special MushFests featuring ONLY 4★ and 5★ Skill Decals!

Not only that, but these ultra-special MushFest events will also feature the brand new decals. One “new decal” will be lined up for each event!


1st Round: Electro Beast
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/a8c03711009edd894159c9dca831838df91e76d3.png[/img]

2nd Round: Arch Wizard
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/7e687ab8d2c7358cd149ba515a312744fde29e21.png[/img]

3rd Round: Queen of Spades
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/9ba714e8300a434545abca4c3c5214b3fe1534f7.png[/img]

For more details, please view the lineup at the Mushroom Club during the event period.




[h2][b]● 3 Free Continues Per Day![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/28/2024 02:00 – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

If you accidentally die in the Tower of Barbs, you can continue up to 3 times a day! The count will be reset every day at 02:00 PST.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/3e0b77021fe87290c2a7a9e0b0ff8526f9f14d19.png[/img]




[h2][b]● 50% Off Sale at Vending Machine “HERNIA”![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/28/2024 02:00 – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

For a limited time, Vending Machine “HERNIA” in your Waiting Room, will have items and mushrooms on sale for 50% off! Take advantage of this before you become 50% off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/a6a24d3463783a2765d827dda5c241cf71208237.jpg[/img]




[h2][b]● FREE Dustin on TENGOKU and NEO Boss Floors![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance) – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

During the event, all Dustin units on Tengoku and NEO boss floors (55F, 60F, 65F, etc.) will change from Dustin 5 to Dustin TD. Smash your way through these areas without worrying about filling up your inventory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/0a67762077469c5000041ae62c37992d1251041c.jpg[/img]




[h2][b]● Earn 3x the Bloodnium in TENGOKU & NEO Areas![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance) – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

During this period, the amount of Bloodnium that can be obtained by defeating Enemies that appear in the TENGOKU and NEO areas will be tripled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/3a9b85a7d057aa2dbefcc5b159ed408229093ed5.png[/img]
Items such as “Splattershroom” are not included.




[h2][b]● 8th Anniversary Special Quests Available![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/28/2024 02:00 – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

Special Quests will be available throughout the event period.
You can collect all types of rare metals repeatedly through those quests! Don’t miss this opportunity to power up your gear to another level!

[b][How to accept the quests][/b]
Talk to Naomi Detox at the HATED ARCADE, or access Superscope 703 to accept the quests.

[i]Additional details about the quests can be viewed on our website:[/i] 
https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7286/




[h2][b]● Limited Time Event: INTO THE PIT[/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/30/2024 02:00 – 1/5/2025 01:59 (PST)[/i]

KNIGHT RIDERS are back! Can you snag their blueprints and make it back to your Waiting Room in one piece?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/b37c4b948bccc6afba713a0660cdb688d9b3b05f.png[/img]

Event Details:
During the event period, venture to TENGOKUJI on the 33rd Floor to challenge the KNIGHT RIDERS. The KNIGHT RIDERS will only appear there at specific dates and times. Defeating the KNIGHT RIDERS may drop one of the following blueprints:

[list]
[*] Executioner’s Ride ZX
[*] Knight’s Helm ZX
[*] Knight’s Armor ZX
[*] Knight’s Leggings ZX
[/list]

[i]Additional details about the event dates and times can be viewed on our website:[/i] 
https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7286/




[h2][b]● Welcome Bonus for New Players![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/27/2024 (Post Maintenance) – 1/6/2025 (Until Maintenance Begins) [/i]

During the event period, all players who register a new LET IT DIE account will receive the items listed below! These gifts come in addition to the exciting daily rewards that all players will receive throughout the 8th anniversary Celebration!

If you’ve been waiting to join the fun – or know someone who has the guts to challenge the Tower of Barbs – now is a great time to jump in and get crazy!

All newly registered players will receive:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/7a239053f868b4e8d4299152afd7eeae4ef4811d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Masamune Blade TDM Blueprint
[*] Death Metal x 20
[*] 40,000 Kill Coins x 5
[*] Golden Bird x 5
[*] 1-Day Express Pass x 5
[*] Vampire (normal) x 1
[*] Giant Killer (normal) x 1
[*] Barbarian (normal) x 1
[/list]

[i]Storage space inside the Reward Box is limited. If the number of items in your Reward Box exceeds the maximum number of available storage slots, you will need to remove some items from your Reward Box in order to receive new items.
[/i]




[h2][b]● 8th Anniversary Special Calendar[/b][/h2]

A sweet 2025 calendar filled with concept art and other rare visuals will be available to download. This calendar can be printed out, or used as wallpaper for your PC. Follow the link below to find out how!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/832bd1ebbeaee338fa2b35f5bceccc808332dbc1.jpg[/img]


[i]Additional details about the calendar can be viewed on our website[/i]: https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/7286/

[*] All terms and conditions on this page are subject to change without notice.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 4.0 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/0500afe39edb1f2ab0c8b37a70562159625e8904.jpg[/img]

Senpai!

[b]At long last, it's here! Version 4.0 with a major update![/b]

Honestly, I was convinced there wouldn't be any more big updates... This is all thanks to all you senpai who have continued playing the game! Thanks, y'all!

After years of hard work, a new area is finally releasing: the NEO D.O.D. area! The NEO D.O.D. area is a brand new high-difficulty area where all enemies are significantly strengthened. It's a high risk, high reward challenge that adrenaline junkies are bound to  love.

By the way, it seems that you can't challenge the NEO D.O.D. area unless you've reached TENGOKU 100F, so if you haven't done that yet, go conquer TENGOKU first! I'll be waiting!



[h2][b]1) NEO D.O.D. Area Revealed![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

After the maintenance on 11/29, for those of you that have made it to Floor 100 of TENGOKU, you’ll be presented with an escalator on Floor 51 that leads to the NEO D.O.D. area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/cf04277e9f8cd8955ed63722fd6ad4952e65af2b.jpg[/img]

The Neo D.OD. area coming this patch is an extremely challenging area where all enemies are significantly strengthened, even by TENGOKU standards. Within the area, all D.O.D. armor and weapons will receive a large faction bonus buff to their stats. It is highly recommended that players bring all D.O.D. equipment when stepping up to this challenge. But select your items carefully before climbing up these floors; there will be a limit to the number of items you can take in your Death Bag.

Of course, with an immense challenge comes immense rewards. Within the area, players have increased chances of obtaining rare D.O.D. ARMS metals, and the equipment obtained here is of similar quality to that of TENGOKU floor 100.

NOTE                                                                                                                                    
*Other faction stages will also be releasing in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/d0cdcd79d31edb49e171925d40cd146edf8f9478.jpg[/img]



[h2][b]2) White Steel (HELL) Unleashed![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

The Neo D.O.D. area features a new difficulty of a returning boss: White Steel of the Four Forcemen can now be fought at the "HELL" difficulty! He'll appear every 10 floors that you progress within the NEO D.O.D. area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/cb99106ce079a04bcbd392c9fb0e384123fe6730.jpg[/img]

Defeat this high-difficulty Forcemen for rare items and new blueprints!

Unlike other difficulties, the "HELL" difficulty has no battle fee and no time limit during battles. However, if you are defeated, there will be a corpse retrieval cost.



[h2][b]3) Armor Skins In Shop![/b][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/29/2023 (Post Maintenance) - TBD[/i]

You'll now be able change the appearance of your Fighter's armor!

Armor Skins will be sliding into Let it Die with Version 4.0! The ability to set armor skins can be accessed by speaking to Kommodore Suzuki at the Choku-Funsha. You'll be able to select any armor enhanced up to +4 as armor skins, letting you conquer the tower with flair!

Armor skins only change the appearance of the armor. The performance of the skin will be the same as that of the armor you have equipped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/257db2edcf81fde96d9344eda085fa5347ad1bb6.jpg[/img]

The status of your armor skins can also be checked in the Option Menu. Armor skins can only be applied to the Fighter currently in play. Please note that "Armor Skins" will not be reflected on some screens, such as the floor results.

    [/tr]
[/table]

notes.title: Celebrating 5 Years of LET IT DIE!
notes.content:
[b][h3][i]Event Duration: 11/24/2021 PST (Post Maint.) – 1/17/2022 PST (Maint. Begins)[/i][/h3][/b]

Yo, senpai!

LET IT DIE celebrates its 5th anniversary on 11/24/2021!*

You know that I wouldn’t allow a momentous occasion such as this to pass by without hosting a special event, right?! Oh man, I’m getting all emotional thinking about the good times we’ve shared together over the last 5 years… Thank you one and all for your continued support of LET IT DIE! What’s that? Yo, I’m not crying… YOU’RE crying!

Yeah, well…

Let’s not argue about how you were just crying and getting emotional. Instead, let’s talk about all the badass stuff we’re gonna do to celebrate 5 years together in the Tower of Barbs!

*[i]LET IT DIE was released in the U.S./Europe on 12/4/2016.[/i]

[h2][u][b]● 5th Anniversary Special Login Bonuses[/b][/u][/h2]
[i]Event Period: 11/24/2021 PST (Post Maintenance)– 1/17/2022 PST (Until Maintenance Begins)[/i]

For about two months, we will be holding a special 5th anniversary login bonus where you can get gorgeous items every day. If you login during the target period, you'll get the following only once!

[list]
[*] 5th Anniversary Equipment "Happy Yuppie Glasses (Blueprint)".
[*] Lost Bag: Rainbow×７bags（Hater Funding Achievement Bonus）
[*] 200,000 Kill Coins (40,000 Kill Coins x 5)
[*] 200,000 SPLithium (40,000 SPLithium x 5)
[*] These happy shades will raise a Fighter’s HP, DEX and VIT by 4%.
[/list]

notes.title: TDM Battle Rush: Season 17 Finale
notes.content:
[i]Event Period: 11/24/2021 (Post Maintenance) – 1/17/2022 (Maintenance Begins)[/i]

Greetings. Tetsuo’s the name.

Thank you for riding the Tokyo Death Metro.
Have you been enjoying TDM Battle Rush Season 16 so far?
This season will come to an end on [b]January 17th, 2022[/b].

As the end draws near, we’ll be revving things up to provide you with something even more exciting:

TDM Battle Rush: Season Finale!

To find out more about what’s coming to a train platform near you, please review the following details.

We greatly appreciate your business and hope you continue to enjoy the Tokyo Death Metro’s Luxury Attack Liner!

[h2][u][b]1. Finale Rank Rewards![/b][/u][/h2]
Players will receive a special blueprint based on their rank at the end of the Season Finale.
Aim for the top as higher ranks will result in better rewards!

[i]Additional details about the rewards can be viewed on our website:[/i] [url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/6032/]https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/6032/[/url]

The Diamond Rank FFWF-285 Flamethrower E TDM reward features +10% attack power and 50% greater durability compared to the base FFWF-103 Flamethrower TDM. In addition, the FFWF-285 Flamethrower E TDM can hold more ammunition and it requires fewer materials for R&D. It’s more economical AND it packs a real punch that you’ll have to feel to believe! Light ’em up and watch ’em burn, man! Please be aware that – compared to the original Flamethrower – the FFWF-285 Flamethrower E TDM will have a much longer wait time before another can be purchased at Chokufunsha.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/3d28ed5ba9b92a7713b08ee33384a1cb497200af.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/025796254e032917439ca1434dbdcda62b4f554b.jpg[/img]

[b]NOTES:[/b]
[list]
[*] FFWF-285 Flamethrower E TDM can be Uncapped past +4 with the necessary materials
[*] FFWF-285 Flamethrower TDM, FFWF-103 Flamethrower E TDM, and FFWF-103 Flamethrower TDM can be upgraded to +4, but cannot advance to the next tier and are not eligible for Uncapping
[*] Special TDM Rank Rewards will be distributed after the maintenance on 1/17/2022
[*] Special TDM Rank Rewards can be obtained from the Reward Box in the Waiting Room
[*] Reward Box has a capacity limit. If the number of items in your Reward Box exceeds the maximum number of available storage slots at the time your Special TDM Rank Rewards are delivered, you will need to remove some items from your Reward Box in order to receive your reward
[/list]

[i]Additional details about the rewards can be viewed on our website:[/i] [url=https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/6032/]https://www.letitdiethegame.com/news.html#/6032/[/url]

[h2][b][u]2. Final Sprint – TDM Points INCREASED![/u][/b][/h2]
[i]Event period: 11/24/2021 (Post Maintenance) – 1/17/2022 (Maintenance Begins)[/i]

During the event period, points obtained from successful Raids/Defenses in TDM will be increased by 50%.

Use this opportunity to obtain a lot of points and boost your rank while you still can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33596455/af4f947a66894b5a380c617c668b91f8b80c0cc5.png[/img]

[h2][u][b]3. Concluding Season 15[/b][/u][/h2]
[i]Event period: 1/17/2022 (Post Maintenance) – TBD[/i]

TDM Battle Rush Season 17 will end at the start of maintenance on 1/17/2022. Once maintenance has concluded, Season 17 will begin and run over a span of 3 months.

[i][b]NOTE:[/b] At the beginning of the new season, all participants’ TDM ranks will be reduced by 2 and placed at sub-rank III. For example, someone standing at the rank Diamond II at the end of Season 17 will start Season 18 at the rank Gold III.[/i]

Senpai!!

Your old Uncle D is BACK!! Did you miss me? I’m sorry if I worried you, senpai. I just needed to take a little vacation, you know? Stretch out my bones, take a short break from all the death and destruction… Man, you should see my vacation photos! I saw some real WILD stuff while I was out in the world. Maybe I’ll show you someday, but I should probably check with my lawyer first. Hehehehe!!

I want to thank each and every one of you for all your messages of love and support while I was away! Naomi saved all of them and I’ve been looking through them all since I returned to the HATED Arcade. Speaking of Naomi, she did a GORETICAL job of running things while I was away! I half expected the arcade to be burned to the ground when I got back, but she kept things running smoothly. Well, as smoothly as possible in a post-Earth Rage world! And don’t worry, I made sure to pay her for all the hours she put in, plus overtime!

Anyway, during my Deathstarter Campaign, I promised my senpais some rewards for downloading the “Uncle Death Super Pack” DLC! Well, one of those rewards was a special new in-game event, and here it is! I call it “Uncle Death Comes Home”! Catchy, right?!

Oh, before I get into the details of this new event, I’ll tell you guys that the “Uncle Death Super Pack” DLC received over 30,000 total downloads! That’s a little less than 6 million, but it’s still pretty badass! Alright, we’ll catch up a little more over the next few weeks. For now, let’s talk about the Uncle Death Comes Home event! HELL YEAH!!

notes.title: Refer-A-Fiend Contest! 8/1/2019 - 8/30/2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/7a7554c4f4b8d342e95bb63cf9b01acb3b9ce172.png[/img]

Event Period: 8/1/2019 00:00 – 8/30/2019 2:59 (PDT)

Yo, senpai!

Guess what? I've decided to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/794600/announcements/detail/1616148671791699868]extend the extra special Welcome Bonuses[/url] that were available to new players during the 5 Million Downloads Celebration! On top of that, I'm turning those new player Welcome Bonuses into a contest that will give longtime players a chance to reap some rewards of their own!

I call it...Refer-A-FIEND! Nice, right? Heheheheh!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/fcad994543a7af9b53f2b5a976a74e0917118706.png[/img]

To enter, just refer your friends to the game by tagging them on social media and tell them why they should try LET IT DIE. Once they start playing, get their Player ID and use that info to fill out the official entry form. If just one of the friends you refer to the game is able to make it past the 3rd Floor boss (COEN) on their newly created account, you will receive 10 Death Metals!

Your friends will get off to a fast start with the help of the new player Welcome Bonuses, and if you refer enough friends to the game to be one of our top 3 referrers you'll win some sick prizes and EVEN MORE Death Metals! Hell yeah!

Okay then, that's enough from me. I'll let one of my flunkies fill you in on the rest of the details, and thanks for spreading the word about LET IT DIE!

TO ENTER:
[olist]

notes.title: Launch Stability Compensation
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596455/c983d7eb979dcb002a87861bb5d3ceed5dfd74bd.png[/img]

Greetings!

We want to start by saying a heartfelt “thank you” to all of our fans in the Steam/PC community! Since the release of LET IT DIE on PC in September, you have shown our game a tremendous amount of love and support, and provided us with a wealth of valuable feedback and suggestions for improving the player experience. With that said, we know that there have been some growing pains along the way, and we truly have appreciated your patience while we worked to resolve some issues that have made life (death?) tough for some of our players.

With the various patches we’ve released since the game’s launch - including the latest patch, Version 3.4.0 - we believe that we have addressed many of the most common issues affecting players. 

In order to both show our support for our loyal PC players as well as compensate for the instability experienced at launch, we are providing the following bonus items to all accounts created before the maintenance period that took place on 10/31/2018:
[list]
[*] 5x Death Metals
[*] 100,000 Kill Coins
[*] 3x 1-Day Express Passes
[*] 1x Golden Bird
[*] 1x Solo Shelter
[/list] 
Finally, we want everyone to know that we are continuing to work on identifying and addressing any and all lingering issues with the game. If you are continuing to experience gameplay/usability issues, or notice any new issues that affect the normal gameplay experience, please follow these steps:
[olist]
[*] Check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/794600/discussions/0/2747650363470798793/] "Troubleshooting" thread [/url]
[*] Check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/794600/discussions/1/] Bugs & Feedback forum[/url] to see if a thread about the issue already exists. If not, make a detailed thread in the forum. Please do not share personal information in these threads.
[*] Follow the instructions below to gather the proper files. If you don't have LOG files don't worry, just send over a DxDiag. Please include the following information when possible:
[list]
[*] 10-Digit User ID
[*] Local time in which the error occurred
[*] Country
[*] Screenshots/Video
[/list]
[*] Put in a detailed [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://lid-na.gungho-support.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=360000112552]support ticket[/url] about the problem.
[/olist]
[b] How to find the correct files to submit with your ticket:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Go to your game files location. Right click on LET IT DIE in the Steam application > Select "Properties" > Select the "Local Files" tab > Select "Browse Local Files"
[*] Locate your Log files. Select the "BrgGame" folder > Select the "Logs" folder
[*] Please make a ZIP file of your Logs folder and a DxDiag to include it with your ticket.
[/olist]
Providing these files will help our development team in their investigation.
